blurb: Guests can visit the taproom and beer garden to enjoy a variety of beers on tap including core favorites and small-batch pilot releases. The brewery offers free tours with no reservation needed. Beer and spirits are available to-go within Texas law limits.
extraNote: No reservation needed for tours; call ahead for groups larger than 10 · Per Texas law, can purchase up to 288oz beer per person per day to go · No outside alcoholic beverages allowed · Taproom at 2250 North US Highway 281, Blanco, TX 78606
